finalText:
**Redis died, and the app followed it down.** Here is the chain.

```
02:14:07 redis refuses connections
      → cache off, every read hits the database
      → requests time out, queue piles up
02:31:44 worker-2 runs out of memory
02:31:52 supervisor kills api — service down
```

Redis lives at `10.0.0.12:6379` and refused every connection. The app retried 13 times over 17 minutes. All 13 were refused, so it never recovered.

The waiting line hit its 500 limit at 02:29:12 and reached 568.

One catch. These lines are from July 4, not last night. Your live log may have rotated away.
